text:
maria_g: Quick sweep before model registry go-live — need final owners, license flags, perf baselines for the new open models. tagging folks who said they'd take ownership. :eyes:

ajay: I can own kylin-7b and the quant profile. will upload perf numbers by EOD.

sam_w: taking orca-mini-12b. cr is open (PR #482). still waiting on a final run with 8k seq.

taylor_r: i did a quick license scan; kylin-7b shows Apache-2.0, orca-mini-12b is a permissive MIT fork but with extra weights provenance note. should we surface that in registry metadata? @legal-bot

legal-bot: Noted. If provenance note mentions third-party checkpoints, we need a short risk blurb. pinged legal for a 1-paragraph template.

maria_g: yes — surface a small "provenance" field and link to legal blurb. can someone add to model metadata schema? devex-bot?

devex-bot: I'll open a tiny PR to the registry schema: adds provenance_url and provenance_notice (optional strings).

ajay: perf numbers incoming. quick heads-up: 8k seq p95 on A100 (q4/INT8) for kylin-7b = 135ms, fp16 = 92ms. will include token-level cost delta.

sam_w: orca-mini-12b 8k p95 looks rougher — ~220ms fp16, 165ms int8. I want a short note recommending 4k for low-latency endpoints.

taylor_r: re: owners — can we have an owner matrix in the metadata? owner, backup, obs-dashboard?

maria_g: yes. owner + oncall + perf-contact. sample snippet: 
```json
{
  "model": "kylin-7b",
  "owner": "ajay",
  "backup": "taylor_r",
  "oncall": "ops_oncall",
  "provenance_url": "https://example.com/kylin-7b-notes",
  "license": "Apache-2.0"
}
```

ops_oncall: thumbs-up. make sure canary plan has fallback to smaller variant (kylin-3b) if latency exceeds SLOs. ops will add routing policy.

maria_g: CR status check — @sam_w, PR #482 needs one more review from eng-runtime (kernel selector changes). can someone from that team quick-review?

sam_w: pinged @ajay and @taylor_r for a quick look at the batching flags.

ajay: I left a small comment on the batching heuristic. nothing blocking. you can merge once tests pass.

taylor_r: merging after CI. I'll also add the provenance_notice text once legal posts it.

legal-bot: Legal posted the template in #legal, short blurb ready: "Third-party checkpoint used; see provenance_url for details and attribution."

maria_g: perfect. last ask: can each owner drop a single-line entry into the registry-launch doc with (1) final perf p95 fp16/int8, (2) license, (3) provenance_url if any, (4) oncall. i'll do a final sweep at 17:30 PT and trigger the publish job.

ajay: done (added kylin-7b row).

sam_w: added orca-mini-12b and a recommended endpoint note about 4k seq.

ops_oncall: added canary window and rollback playbook link.

maria_g: thank you all. if anything blocks, post in this thread. otherwise, we plan to flip registry to public tomorrow 09:00 PT. :rocket:
